title: Feelings and inner states
theme: emotions, moods and states of mind
goal: Recognise and use 24 words for feelings, moods and states of mind.

example.fr: Elle a eu beaucoup de chagrin après le départ de son ami.
example.en: She felt a lot of grief after her friend left.

example.fr: La jalousie peut détruire un couple.
example.en: Jealousy can destroy a relationship.

example.fr: Il a appelé le 911 parce qu'il était en détresse.
example.en: He called 911 because he was in distress.

example.fr: Les enfants regardaient le film avec terreur.
example.en: The children were watching the film in terror.

example.fr: J'ai eu la trouille avant mon entrevue !
example.en: I had the jitters before my interview!

items.note: Informal. Avoir la trouille = to be scared.

example.fr: Après son divorce, il a fait une dépression.
example.en: After his divorce, he went through a depression.

example.fr: Elle a poussé un long soupir.
example.en: She let out a long sigh.

example.fr: Il a un grand désir de voyager.
example.en: He has a strong desire to travel.

example.fr: L'infirmière parle aux patients avec compassion.
example.en: The nurse speaks to patients with compassion.

example.fr: Ma grand-mère est pleine de sagesse.
example.en: My grandmother is full of wisdom.

example.fr: J'ai suivi mon intuition et j'ai accepté le poste.
example.en: I followed my gut feeling and took the job.

example.fr: Mei trouve son inspiration dans la nature.
example.en: Mei finds her inspiration in nature.

example.fr: Tout le monde mérite d'être traité avec dignité.
example.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with dignity.

example.fr: J'ai une sensation de froid dans les mains.
example.en: I have a cold feeling in my hands.

example.fr: J'ai fait une bêtise : j'ai oublié mes clés dans l'auto.
example.en: I did something silly: I forgot my keys in the car.

items.en: to care about, to worry about

example.fr: Il ne se soucie pas de l'opinion des autres.
example.en: He doesn't care about other people's opinion.

example.fr: Sans travail depuis six mois, Karim était désespéré.
example.en: Out of work for six months, Karim was desperate.

example.fr: Merci pour tes excuses sincères.
example.en: Thank you for your sincere apology.

example.fr: Je suis conscient du problème.
example.en: I am aware of the problem.

example.fr: Le cycliste est resté inconscient quelques minutes.
example.en: The cyclist stayed unconscious for a few minutes.

example.fr: Je suis confus, je ne comprends plus rien.
example.en: I'm confused, I don't understand anything any more.

example.fr: Raj est obsédé par son téléphone.
example.en: Raj is obsessed with his phone.

example.fr: C'est un homme solitaire qui vit à la campagne.
example.en: He's a solitary man who lives in the country.

example.fr: Ce documentaire sur l'Arctique est fascinant.
example.en: This documentary about the Arctic is fascinating.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- [[Avoir la trouille]] is informal; in formal speech say [[avoir peur]].
- **False friend:** [[confus]] often means *embarrassed* ([[Je suis confus]] = I'm so sorry).
- [[Conscient de]] = aware of; [[inconscient]] can also mean reckless.
- [[Faire une dépression]] = to go through depression.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: Match each feeling to its meaning.
Match each adjective to its meaning.
Olivier spilled coffee on his boss. He says: « Je suis vraiment ___. » Which word fits best?
blocks.explain: [[Je suis confus]] is a polite way to say you are embarrassed and sorry.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence means “I followed my gut feeling”?
blocks.explain: [[L’intuition]] is the gut feeling that guides a decision.

blocks.prompt: I am aware of the problem. (man speaking)
She is obsessed with her phone.
accept: Elle est obsédée par son téléphone.
Elle est obsédée par son cellulaire.
Elle est obsédée par son portable.
blocks.explain: Use [[obsédé par]], with the feminine ending -e for elle.

blocks.text: J'ai eu la ___ avant mon examen !
blocks.en: I had the jitters before my exam!
blocks.explain: [[Avoir la trouille]] is the informal way to say you were scared.

blocks.text: Il ne se ___ pas de ce que pensent les autres.
blocks.en: He doesn't care about what other people think.
blocks.explain: [[Se soucier de]] is a regular -er verb: il se soucie.

blocks.fr: Ma grand-mère est pleine de sagesse.
blocks.explain: [[Sagesse]] is spelled with a double s, so it sounds like s, not z.

blocks.fr: Elle a poussé un long soupir.
blocks.en: She let out a long sigh.
blocks.explain: [[Pousser un soupir]] = to let out a sigh.

summary:
- Name strong feelings: [[chagrin, jalousie, détresse, terreur, trouille]]
- Talk about inner qualities: [[sagesse, intuition, dignité, compassion]]
- Describe a state of mind: [[conscient, confus, désespéré, obsédé]]
